title: Collab-Overcooked: Benchmarking and Evaluating Large Language Models as Collaborative Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Segmenting input prompts into distinct components and analyzing attention weight distributions to determine if models overemphasize task execution details while undervaluing collaboration-specific information.

Reordering the steps of task recipes to isolate positional effects and evaluate whether collaboration performance degradation is caused by the sequence position of an action, revealing pretraining biases that favor early sequence completions.
